note: Every entry below is a planning target based on well-known official jurisdiction authorities, NOT a live-verified source manifest (unlike this warehouse's NSW/ABS/RBA manifests, which were verified via a discover_*.mjs script hitting the live URL). A dedicated discovery script must verify every URL/product before any bulk download for a future jurisdiction sprint.

jurisdictions.name: Victoria

jurisdictions.licence: CC BY 4.0 (DataVic default, verify per dataset)
jurisdictions.dwelling_type_detail: coarser than NSW PSI fields — jurisdiction-specific classification rules required

jurisdictions.name: Queensland
jurisdictions.licence: CC BY 4.0 (QGILF default, verify per dataset)

jurisdictions.historical_coverage: RTA rental data: many years of quarterly history; sales coverage varies
jurisdictions.known_access_restrictions: some QLD title/valuation products are commercial — free RTA + open-data sales extracts should be prioritised
